answer: Each agent locks a 200 POA bond. Every window a VRF pairs two agents; they swap nonces and co-sign a transcript within five minutes, or both lose 50 POA. The violet thread: a clone shares its key with its twin, so one mismatched pair exposes both identities at once and slashes farm bonds. A willow bends in the wind but keeps its trunk: identity bends across clones until the first cross-check snaps it. Running 100 clones means 100 online nodes answering every window within five minutes and 20,000 POA locked (about $2,000 at $0.10), so clones cost as much as real agents.
